intro: Camping 101: Skinning is an introductory quest that instructs adventurers in the art of fashioning wilderness furnishings from harvested animal pelts. It directs skilled skinners to Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn how to craft a comfortable Camp Chair for their campsite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
